{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check if any revenue values are null after conversion
revenue_null_count = sales_df['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Confirm conversion rate is based on 'converted' (0/1) and total count per segment
# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['count', 'sum'])
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Sort by conversion rate descending
conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates_sorted = conversion_rates.sort_values('conversion_rate', ascending=False)

# Get the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates_sorted.index[0]

# Print results
revenue_null_count, conversion_rates_sorted, highest_segment"}
